mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, member_id, content, parent_id, group_id, depth) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{groupId}, #{depth})
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET is_deleted = true WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.member_id, m.username AS author_username, CASE WHEN m.role = 'ROLE_ADMIN' THEN 'ADMIN' WHEN bm.board_role = 'MANAGER' THEN 'MANAGER' ELSE NULL END AS author_role, pm.username AS parent_author_username, c.content, c.created_at, c.parent_id, c.group_id, c.depth, c.is_deleted FROM comments c JOIN members m ON c.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN comments pc ON c.parent_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN members pm ON pc.member_id = pm.id LEFT JOIN board_members bm ON bm.member_id = c.member_id AND bm.board_id = #{boardId} WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY COALESCE(c.group_id, c.id), c.created_at
